description: Ground-truth incident scenario catalog for EvoOps autonomous investigation and remediation.

scenarios.name: Payment Service Downstream Latency & Timeout

symptoms.metrics: Elevated P95/P99 latency in api-gateway and order-service; increased request duration in payment-service.
symptoms.traces: Long horizontal span on payment-service POST /payments/process (>3s) causing parent span /orders to stall.
symptoms.logs: Gateway log contains slow client response warning; payment-service shows delayed request processing.

scenarios.misleading_signals: API Gateway and Order Service show high latency, which could lead a naive engineer to suspect gateway or database saturation.
scenarios.root_cause: Artificial execution delay injected into payment-service HTTP request pipeline.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Reset payment-service chaos or trigger downstream circuit breaker / restart payment-service.

scenarios.name: Inventory Service HTTP 500 Internal Error Surge

symptoms.metrics: Spike in 5xx HTTP response codes on inventory-service; drop in successful orders on order-service.
symptoms.traces: Red error spans on inventory-service GET /inventory/{item_id} and POST /inventory/reserve.
symptoms.logs: HTTPException: 500 Internal Server Error in inventory-service request handlers.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Order Service returns 500 to the client, masking that the failure originated in the upstream inventory check.
scenarios.root_cause: 85% error rate injection on inventory-service endpoints simulating an internal application crash or unhandled exception.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Reset inventory-service chaos or redeploy last known stable configuration.

scenarios.name: Order Service Database Query Saturation

symptoms.metrics: Order creation latency jumps from ~50ms to >4000ms; connection hold times spike.
symptoms.traces: Trace span for order-service POST /orders remains open for 4+ seconds.
symptoms.logs: Database query execution logs exceed slow query threshold.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Client experiences timeout at API Gateway; user checkout fails before order state is returned.
scenarios.root_cause: Simulated heavy query load / slow table locks on PostgreSQL order table.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Kill blocking database queries, optimize table indexing, or clear order-service connection delays.

scenarios.name: API Gateway Service Unavailable (503) Overload

symptoms.metrics: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable rates spike at the front edge.
symptoms.traces: Root span on api-gateway terminates immediately with status code 503 without invoking downstream services.
symptoms.logs: Simulated Incident Fault (HTTP 503) logged at API Gateway.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Downstream microservices (order, payment, inventory) report 100% healthy metrics, despite total customer outage.
scenarios.root_cause: Edge proxy rate limiter or thread starvation simulation triggering 503 rejections.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Scale API Gateway instances, reset edge rate limits, or clear injected fault.

scenarios.name: Redis Cache Degradation on Inventory Service

symptoms.metrics: 502 Bad Gateway responses on stock verification; cache miss fallback overhead.
symptoms.traces: Inventory service traces show intermittent failures and 500ms delay per stock lookup.
symptoms.logs: Redis connection timeout or cache read fallback exceptions.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Downstream databases show sudden spike in read IOPS because cache misses force database reads.
scenarios.root_cause: Redis connectivity degradation or cache partition.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Flush Redis cache, verify Redis container health, and reset inventory-service fault.

scenarios.name: Async Notification Worker Latency Spike

symptoms.metrics: Notification delivery latency spikes; RabbitMQ consumer acknowledgment delays.
symptoms.traces: Trace span for notification handling extends beyond 2.5 seconds.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Order placement succeeds immediately with HTTP 200, but customers report missing receipt notifications.
scenarios.root_cause: Artificial execution delay in background worker event consumption.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Scale notification workers or reset notification chaos latency.

scenarios.name: Cross-Service Network Latency Cascade

symptoms.metrics: Concurrent elevation in latency across API Gateway and Order Service with intermittent 504 Gateway Timeouts.
symptoms.traces: Spans show delayed inter-service HTTPX client communication.
symptoms.logs: HTTPX connection pool warnings and retry attempts logged.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Looks like an infrastructure VM or network interface saturation affecting all services.
scenarios.root_cause: Network packet delay and intermittent drop simulation.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Reset order-service network parameters, flush stale HTTP connections.

scenarios.name: Payment Third-Party Gateway 504 Gateway Timeout

symptoms.metrics: 60% failure rate with HTTP 504 on payment endpoints.
symptoms.traces: Order trace stops and marks error on the payment processing child span.
symptoms.logs: Payment processing timeout: upstream payment gateway unreachable.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Order service logs report payment failure, but payments database is completely idle.
scenarios.root_cause: External banking acquirer or payment processing partner gateway timeout.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Failover to secondary payment provider or reset payment-service fault.

scenarios.name: Inventory Reservation Resource Exhaustion

symptoms.logs: Resource reservation conflict: lock contention on SKU.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Can be mistaken for an actual inventory stockout rather than a locking defect.
scenarios.root_cause: Concurrency conflict simulation on inventory reservation.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Clear reservation locks, reset inventory chaos state.

scenarios.name: System-Wide Cascading Brownout

symptoms.metrics: Widespread latency increase across all tiers, elevated 5xx rates at gateway, consumer queue buildup.
symptoms.traces: Multiple cascading error spans propagating from order-service down to payment and inventory.
symptoms.logs: Cascade of failed downstream HTTP requests and thread exhaustion.

scenarios.misleading_signals: Every dashboard tile in Grafana turns red simultaneously, making root cause pinpointing difficult.
scenarios.root_cause: Core order coordinator degradation triggering cascading timeout and retry loops throughout the cluster.
scenarios.recommended_remediation: Reset order-service fault injection, purge dead-letter messages, restart order-service.
